To deploy and mint a NFT on NEAR with the global contract, follow these three steps:

1. Run a NEAR CLI command that attaches the pre‑deployed global NFT contract to your account and initializes it with your own owner ID and collection metadata, for example:  
`near contract deploy <account-id> use-global-account-id nft.globals.primitives.near \ with-init-call new \ json-args '{"owner_id":"<account-id>","metadata":{"spec":"nft-1.0.0","name":"MY_NFT","symbol":"MYN","decimals":0,"media":"<url>","reference":"<url>","reference_hash":"<hash>"}}'`.  
2. The contract you deployed exposes the `nft_mint` function that you call on your account ID to create a new token; run it like:  
`near call <account-id> nft_mint '{"token_id":"token-1","receiver_id":"<account-id>","token_metadata":{"title":"Example Token","description":"An example NFT","media":"<url>","copies":1}}' --accountId <account-id>`.  
3. After the `nft_mint` transaction succeeds, the specified token will be stored in your collection and can be queried or transferred using the standard NEP‑171 functions.
